attributes.description: The widget extended data for each supported language.

dataType.description: The data type for the extended data.

LanguageData.description: The extended data for a language.

languageId.description: The languageId of the extended data.

assignment.description: The page layout assignment. The matching layout assignment is returned for layouts requested for a specific page.

default.description: The flag that indicates whether the page layout is a default page layout. Only one default page layout should exist for each page layout type.

description.description: The description of the page layout.

deviceClass.description:
The class of the device that this layout is designed to render a store page for, for example:
  • Mobile
  • Web
  • Any (responsive web page)

endDate.description: The end time for the page layout. If the end time is null, then the page layout will run indefinitely.

id.description: The unique numeric ID for identifying the page layout.

layoutGroup.description: The layout group this layout belongs to.

managingTool.description: Indicates which tool manages the page layout.

memberId.description: The unique numeric ID for identifying the organization that owns the layout.

priority.description: The priority of the page layout. The default value is 0.

startDate.description: The start time for the page layout. If the start time is null, then the page layout can start immediately.

state.description: The state of the page layout.

storeId.description: The unique numeric ID for identifying the store.

template.description: Indicates whether the page layout is a layout template or not.

templateId.description: The unique identifier of the template, based on which the page layout is created.

activityId.description: The unique numeric ID for identifying the web activity that defines a rule and mapping between a page and a layout.

applyToSubPage.description: Flag that indicates whether the layout assignment applies to the sub-pages instead of only the page that is indicated by the page name. The value of this attribute indicates the type of sub-pages where the page applies. For example, 'CatalogEntry' indicates that the page layout applies to all the sub-catalog entry pages.

id.description: The unique numeric ID for identifying the layout assignment.

pageId.description: The unique numeric ID for identifying the page.

propagateToSubLevels.description: Flag that indicates whether the page layout propagates to sub-levels.  It is typically used for 1)Category pages and 2)all child catalog entry pages under a Category.

storeId.description: The unique numeric ID for identifying the store.

extendedData.description: The list of extended data for the widget.

id.description: The unique numeric ID for identifying the widget.

layoutId.description: The unique numeric ID for identifying the page layout.

parentWidgetId.description: The unique numeric ID for identifying the parent widget.

parentWidgetName.description: The name of the parent widget.

properties.description: The list of properties for the widget.

slotName.description: The name of the slot where the widget is included.

widgetDefinitionId.description: The unique numeric ID for identifying the widget definition for the widget.

widgetDefinitionName.description: The widget definition name of the widget.

widgetSequence.description: The order that the child widget or child container is displayed within a parent container.

name.description: The name of the widget property.
